complete_examples.text: To investigate the influence of the nonlinear curved beam element on the vehicle–curved track system, the static deformation and the dynamic responses of the vehicle–curved track systems that adopt different curved beam elements are compared with each other.

Conclusion In this paper, a vehicle–curved track dynamic coupled model is established, in which the curved beam element with consideration of the geometric nonlinearity and large displacement is used to simulate the rail.
